## Approved plan task V1

- Review boundary leakage across all edited seams, especially BO→Channels→Engine, opaque transport metadata, configuration scope and privilege propagation.
- Run isolated affected tests and `mix q` per implementation issue. Run existing relevant browser coverage during development; new consolidated E2E follows B3 approval.
- After implementation and PR review approval, perform the workflow-required coverage handoff; use current coverage tooling and record exceptions rather than imposing per-task numeric gates.
- Run final `mix precommit` per the authoritative workflow before requesting final approval. Resolve failures, and repeat only when changes/failures justify it.
- Record commands/results and remaining external-widget integration work.
- Commit, push and merge remain separately authorized actions.

## Execution requirements
Branch: refactor/webbridge. Source: GitHub www-zaq-ai/zaq#830. Read AGENTS.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, and applicable service guides before implementation. Shared contracts, module responsibilities, reuse evidence, decisions and regression obligations are in parent zaq-pkd. Write specified immediate tests first; use real internal boundaries and mock only external edges. Preserve canonical-history authorization, config-scoped delivery and Engine admission/finalization. New/substantially rewritten feature E2E must wait for B3 human approval. Inbound message.edit is excluded; outbound streaming edits remain included.


## Sequencing
Blocked by zaq-pkd.14 (D2).
Final validation task; umbrella completion requires this task and all other children to be complete.
Human BO approval: zaq-pkd.7. Persistent consolidated E2E/regression issue: zaq-pkd.8. Widget decision gate: zaq-pkd.9.

comments.text: Final precommit normal-scheduler result: 48 doctests, 213 properties, 10258 tests, 17 failures, one skipped (101 excluded). Quality passed. One confirmed C4 regression is malformed listener-spec error/log taxonomy vs existing EmailBridge assertion; fixed to preserve {:invalid_child_spec, spec} before any state startup. Remaining failures span Workflow batch dispatch, Telegram replay, EmailBridge acknowledgement, Jido updates, async SQL sandbox contention and integration timeouts; isolation reruns in progress, no assumption yet that they are unrelated. No assertions weakened, no commits/pushes, no final approval requested. D1 protocol owner/handoff authored and linked; numerical coverage remains after implementation review approval per workflow.

Additional routing regression traced to 0786bbc1 (B1): strict result normalization incorrectly treats canonical {:ok, :duplicate_incoming} admission as an error. Extended existing CommunicationBridge normalizer to acknowledge that explicit no-op receipt, with a focused single-dispatch assertion; unexpected-response assertion remains unchanged. Reuse assessment: extend existing role-dispatch normalization, local-only transport coordination, no new Action/tool/domain permission or execution path. The earlier malformed-spec compatibility fix passed 43 targeted tests (75 excluded). Isolated full failing suites are running serially; remaining unknown-response behavior is not silently relaxed, and no assertion has been weakened.

Isolation complete: 7/12 previously failing files passed; remaining Telegram/ingestion/canonical failures are SQL sandbox checkout errors. EmailBridge acknowledgement regression is deterministic and comes from our B1 shared normalizer change (0786bbc1). Added a generic explicit acknowledgement-only option and enabled it only at the existing EmailBridge caller; default strict response assertion remains intact and acknowledgement mode still propagates {:error, :unauthorized}. Canonical duplicate admission is separately acknowledged without a second routing dispatch. Serial quality/relevant regression/remaining failure verification is running. Jido integer receipt assertion also fails deterministically; its source and test last changed in baseline 2fde2a58 before this refactor, not our commits. That existing contract conflict is not silently fixed or attributed to current source changes. No altered assertions or Git mutations.

User authorized rebasing onto updated feature/issue-768-history-a-integration instead of duplicating its pre-existing fixes. Rebase complete: base 73df6235 contains f634e990 CI isolation/receipt fix and 73df6235 boundary updates; seven WebBridge commits replayed, HEAD now 99b306e2. Resolved committed conflicts preserving Engine-owned ChannelConfig, DeliveryConfirmation/ConnectorRuntime/Settings, shared web ingress and agent-hop option without reintroducing the removed capture_history caller flag. Preserved uncommitted tracked/untracked source in stash 9170531076d53062f57afa0cbd06de93c03bb5cb and recovery branch backup/webbridge-pre-history-rebase-20261004; restored all 10 untracked files byte-for-byte before adapting schema aliases. Resolved two stash conflicts preserving upstream confidential connector archival alongside widget conversation action. Working changes remain uncommitted/unstaged; no push, no new implementation commit. Test compilation with warnings-as-errors PASS after migrating new helper/fixtures to Engine.ChannelConfig. Focused post-rebase tests including upstream integer receipt fix are running. All prior validation is historical and must be rerun on rebased code; recovery refs intentionally retained.

Post-rebase test gate blocked before test execution: PostgreSQL localhost:5432 refuses connections; pg_isready -h localhost -p 5432 confirms no response. No tests counted or attributed to source failures. git diff --check PASS and branch divergence is 7/0 (updated parent entirely included). Test compile passed after schema alias port. Fixed previously reported cyclomatic issue via small acknowledgement-normalization extraction without changing error/permission assertions. DB-independent mix q is running. Recovery stash and backup branch remain; working source is uncommitted and no push occurred.
